name: Contractual obligations tracker
description: Supplier-contract obligation tracking workflow under NIS2 Article 21(2)(d) supply-chain security. On each execution, ingest a supplier contract reference, extract the per-clause obligations the operator has accepted from that contract, schedule the next review date for each obligation against the operator's review-cadence policy, and emit one obligation-evidence artifact pinning the contract id, the extracted obligation set, the per-obligation review-state, and the provenance envelope. SKELETON: the five-state topology (workflow_start -> ingest-contract -> extract-obligations -> schedule-review -> emit-obligation-evidence -> workflow_end) and the x_secops_ng joins into the control / telemetry layers are pinned at this layer; per-target compiler emitters and the canonical primitive bindings land in the CORE-FANOUT sibling cards. Opens the NIS2 Article 21(2)(d) supply-chain control family at the workflow layer (per-entity supplier-contract obligation surface).

__execution_id__.description: Per-execution identifier issued by the compile target's workflow runtime (n8n execution id, Temporal workflow run id, LangGraph thread/checkpoint id). Pinned by the upstream runtime; the workflow reads it for the obligation-evidence artifact join.

__contract_ref__.description: Pointer to the operator's supplier-contract record under review on this execution. Operator-configured; the workflow reads it as the opaque pointer to a contract held in the operator's document store. The framework ships no default document-store endpoint and no vendor SDK bundling — the operator supplies whatever store is in scope (a sovereign EU object store, an on-prem document management system, a Git-managed contract repository).

__contract_record_ref__.description: Pointer to the ingested contract record produced by ingest-contract. Closed shape per CORE sibling card; contract-id keyed, supplier-classification and effective-date envelope valued. Consumed by extract-obligations.

__obligation_set_ref__.description: Pointer to the per-contract obligation set produced by extract-obligations — one entry per declared obligation with the clause reference, obligation text, obligation kind (security control, audit right, attestation cadence, sub-processor disclosure), and the contractual review/expiry cadence. Consumed by schedule-review and by emit-obligation-evidence.

__review_schedule_ref__.description: Pointer to the per-obligation review schedule produced by schedule-review — one entry per obligation with the next-review-due timestamp derived deterministically from the obligation's contractual cadence and the operator's review-policy. Consumed by emit-obligation-evidence.

__obligation_artifact_ref__.description: Pointer to the obligation-evidence artifact emitted by emit-obligation-evidence, shaped against schemas/evidence/contractual-obligations.schema.json.

action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: ingest-contract
action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Read the supplier-contract record referenced by __contract_ref__ from the operator-supplied document store and bind it to a normalised in-workflow contract record (contract_id, supplier_ref, effective_at, expires_at, jurisdiction). Read-only by contract; the workflow MUST NOT mutate the source document. Document-store endpoint is operator-configured — the framework ships no default non-EU endpoint and no hosted DMS dependency.

action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: extract-obligations
action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Walk the ingested contract record and extract the per-clause obligations the operator has accepted from that contract. Per obligation, capture the clause reference, the obligation text (operator-canonicalised string — no commentary, no rewrites at this layer), the obligation kind (security-control commitment, audit-right window, attestation cadence, sub-processor disclosure, breach-notification cadence), and any contractual review/expiry cadence the clause itself declares. Deterministic on the same contract record — re-extraction under the same inputs re-derives the same obligation set.

action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: schedule-review
action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Derive the per-obligation review schedule from the extracted obligation set and the operator's review-cadence policy. For each obligation, compute the next-review-due timestamp deterministically from (last_reviewed_at, contractual cadence declared by the clause, operator-policy fallback cadence). Pure derivation — the workflow MUST NOT contact the supplier on this step, and the schedule is computed in-band from the obligation record and the policy alone.

action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: emit-obligation-evidence
action--10101010-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Combine the ingested contract record, the extracted obligation set, and the per-obligation review schedule into one obligation-evidence artifact shaped against schemas/evidence/contractual-obligations.schema.json (stream: contractual-obligations). The artifact carries the workflow id, execution id, compile target, regulation_refs (nis2:art-21-2-d, optionally nis2:art-22 for the Union-level overlay), control_refs, the contract id, the obligation set, the per-obligation review-state, and the provenance envelope. Emission is byte-stable: same execution inputs, same compile target, same obligation set re-derive the same artifact_id. Destination is operator-configured — no default non-EU endpoint.
